SYNTHETIC TEST VACANCY — NOT A REAL OPENING
Management Analyst, GS-11
Agency: Example Federal Operations Agency
Duty station: Washington, DC
Salary: $82,764 - $107,590 per year

Duties
Analyze program operations and performance data to identify trends and recommend improvements.
Prepare reports and briefings describing program performance, operating costs, and administrative procedures.
Coordinate with program officials to track corrective actions and reporting deadlines.
Review budget execution data and explain variances to management.

Qualifications
Applicants must demonstrate one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-09 level in the federal service. Specialized experience includes: analyzing program performance data; evaluating administrative processes and recommending improvements; preparing written reports and briefings for management; and tracking program expenditures against an operating budget.
Experience may have been obtained in federal, private-sector, or nonprofit employment. Your resume must describe your own work and show dates and hours worked per week.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities
Ability to analyze program data.
Ability to communicate findings in writing.
Knowledge of administrative procedures and budget tracking.

Desired, but not required
Experience using SQL databases and formulating federal budget requests.

Required documents
Resume of no more than two pages. Include name, contact details, job titles, employers, month/year employment dates, hours worked per week, duties, accomplishments, and relevant education. Do not include a Social Security number or classified information.
